name: 担当を休む日の申請
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
ONE Lighthouse LH11-0016 担当を休む日の申請 form. Image1 ORIGINAL Deputy source controls checkbox/triangle/chip geometry, optical proportions, alignment, spacing and fine controls ahead of rough SECONDARY Japanese mock Image2. Image3 approved bus is white surface/forest action-gradient style only. Target just the leave request form; no app backdrop, back buttons, profile photos or page title.
Pure white #FFFFFF canvas, compact logical640x456 white rounded form surface with fine neutral border and soft downward shadow. Two top date rows: left labels 「開始日」「終了日」; each has an actual small CHECKED SQUARE CHECKBOX with white check and label 「終日」, then a WHITE date field labelled 「日付」, exact value 「10月18日（日）」. Restore source checkbox anatomy; do NOT use the mock's mint 終日 pill as a substitute for a control. Both checkboxes checked. Then full-width white dropdown labelled 「欠席の種類」 value 「予定によるお休み」, with small original-style downward triangular caret at right. Comment field labelled 「コメント」 with exact text 「担当の引き継ぎは済んでいます。」. Notification field labelled 「通知するリーダー」 containing a small white/neutral-outline selected PERSON CHIP 「山田 太郎」, faithfully matching source selected-member chip anatomy, not a mint chip or plain ungrouped field value. Footer: secondary WHITE neutral-outline button 「閉じる」 left, forest-gradient primary 「申請する」 right.
Preserve all saved Japanese content, one-day dates, checked all-day states, dropdown, comment, selected leader and two actions. No title, extra manager, new date, counts or new controls. Use source small control shapes and optical weight, no decorative icons. Meiryo14/24regular body,12/16regular field labels, tracking0; modest button weight, no all-bold fields. Clear aligned columns and compact readable spacing.
Accent decision: original blue checked boxes and purple active/action colors become coherent forest-green #1F6444 selections and primary action. Primary button smooth135-degree #174C36 → #1F6444 at58% → #2D8F5E, gentle light edge, white legible label, restrained shadow. Utility caret slate #526173; selected leader chip WHITE with fine neutral outline. Close button white/slate, no mint fill. No other semantic accent is needed. All page/input/card surfaces white; quiet neutral boundaries, no gray/mint wash, rainbow form icons, heavy glow or gloss. Static raster design candidate only, no actual submission/notification implied.
reviewNotes: 原画優先のチェック箱二つ/下三角/白リーダーチップと日本語/日付/コメント/二操作を保持。生成で原画の可視状態にないチップ削除Xが追加され、余分な操作として除去が必要。白/森林緑/中立を確認。画像修正待ち。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
